silo.definition:
n. a cylindrical tower used for storing silage
n. military installation consisting of an underground structure where ballistic missiles can be stored and fired
silo.translation:
n. 筒仓, 青贮窖
[机] 储仓

siloam.translation: n. (《圣经·约翰福音》中记载的耶路撒冷城外的) 西罗亚水池

siloed.translation:
n. 筒仓；青贮窖；飞弹发射井
vt. 把…存入青贮窖；把…储存在筒仓内
n. (Silo)人名；(意、西、芬、瑞典)西洛

silom.translation: [地名] [巴布亚新几内] 锡洛姆

silometer.translation: 料仓料位计; 仓贮指示器

silos.definition:
n. a cylindrical tower used for storing silage
n. military installation consisting of an underground structure where ballistic missiles can be stored and fired
silos.translation: n. 筒仓( silo的复数形式 ); （核武器的）发射井; （危险物品的）地下贮藏库; 青贮窖

siloxane.definition: n any of a large class of compounds that have alternate silicon and oxygen atoms
